source_text: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) emphasize that newborn circumcision complication rates are low (0.2-0.6%), safer than in older children or adults, and that benefits—encompassing UTI prevention, STI mitigation, and reduced phimosis—outweigh risks when performed electively. [121] [79]
